title: Mom's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Dip
description: A creamy, no bake cookie dough dip with cream cheese, butter, brown sugar, vanilla, and mini chocolate chips.
ingredients: 128 g mini chocolate chips (¾ cup, approximate)
steps: Beat the softened butter and cream cheese with a mixer until smooth.
Mix in the powdered sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla until combined.
Stir in the mini chocolate chips.
Store the dip in the refrigerator.
notes: Transcribed from Mom's handwritten recipe. The gram weights for the ingredients originally measured by cups and spoons are approximate. This is an egg free, flour free dessert dip; the name describes its cookie dough flavor.
